question:
In the given figure, l is parallel to m and m is parallel to n. Find the value of x°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a25823b66cabf3e653f6776d9b63213d73a2042b1c95c40b4fa3f770bfd42633.png]
solution:
**Given:****
l ll m ll n

∠CAD = 50**°

**Formula used:**

vertically opposite angles are same 

linear pair of angles= 180°

**Calculations:**

∠CAD = ∠ACB= 50°( vertically opposite angle)

∠ACB + ∠X= 180° ( linear pair of angles)

∠X= 180 - 50= 130°

Therefore, the value of x is 130°.
